current.text: He is projected to come off the bench. The starting guard spot next to Curry is open among Podziemski, Melton and Santos, and he has an outside shot at it.
His recovery from the ACL injury is still a concern for his knee and his minutes.

If he starts and plays about 28 minutes, he is worth rostering in every league and can beat his 179 ranking from last season. Without that role he is not worth it in 10-team leagues and only worth considering in 12-team leagues.
Ranked in tier 9 of the point guard tiers.
Josh expects him to do a bit more than last season.
Golden State's depth is very poor. They struggle to field a 10-man rotation, so minutes should go up across the rotation.
Golden State may treat this as a gap year and may rest veterans to protect lottery odds. Experts expect Warriors players to fade as the season goes on.
Golden State has 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most. Its schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28.

durable.text: He is a steals specialist. Steals are his one category far above the top 250 pool.
He has been an above-average three-point shooter for his career, at 36 to 39% before last season's slump after his return from injury.
He is a good defender but not a primary creator.
His FG% is low for a guard on about 11 shots a game, so he fits teams that punt FG%.
He has had an ACL injury.

note: At Yahoo rank 245 and ESPN rank 180, with 0 USD value on both sites, he falls outside the 144 players drafted in our league, so do not bid on him. He is a steals specialist (z +2.1) with a weak FG% for a guard, so he mainly suits punt FG% builds that want steals. In the first weeks, check whether he wins the starting guard spot and reaches about 28 minutes, and watch his knee. If he does, add him from waivers.
